entries.clue: Generations-long prose epic of feuds, farms and voyages
Wedge-bladed tool swung two-handed to split logs
Norse name of a walled northern city, revived by its Coppergate museum
Green route open to walkers, cyclists and riders on horseback
Warrior who charged in a howling trance, armour disdained
Unlocked stone hut in the hills, free to any walker who reaches it
Viking-age memorial slab, its message spelled in angular staves
Waiting room at an airport, or the carpeted side of a two-bar pub
Century off the oche, and 2,240 pounds on a weighbridge
Curtains drawn and the doors shut fast, long after the law's hour
Ring that holds a Scout's neckerchief in place at the throat
Erikson who beached in North America five centuries before Columbus
Back-of-bar frame that the spirit bottles hang from
Plastic badge on the pump that names the beer it draws
